public_freeze_repair.patch: Use checked-out V231 -> V80 -> V79 source ownership plus the durable live V79 selector, Jordan Love identity, cold full-analysis proof, warm reload proof, runtime-error scan, and warm-regression guard. No product/runtime/model/data/math/sportsbook change.

public_runtime_refresh.reason: Certified main owns V231 -> V80 -> V79, but public production did not expose the V79 lazy-detail selector. Force a Streamlit restart with an unused app marker and recertify Steps 3 and 4 together.

full_redeploy_repair.reason: App-only refresh merged successfully but public Streamlit still did not expose certified V79. Touch requirements.txt without changing dependency versions to force a full Community Cloud redeploy, then recertify Steps 3 and 4 on public production.
